flags.water-sewer: Whether water and sewer service is available for this parcel is unknown and wasn't scored, so it's worth checking directly with the utility provider [utilities.water_sewer].
flags.adu: A proposed rule (not yet law) would let this property have up to 2 small accessory dwelling units by right, each no more than 1,000 square feet and 30 feet tall, without requiring the owner to live there — but this is still under Council review with a hearing scheduled [zoning.district, reform.status].
flags.parking-minimum: The same proposed rule would remove requirements for off-street parking, which could free up land and money for more housing, but again this is not law yet [reform.status].
flags.affordable-housing-bonus: Under the proposed rule, this parcel could optionally use an Affordable Housing Bonus since it's outside the Inclusionary Housing Overlay area, but this bonus is not yet in effect [overlay.iz, reform.status].
flags.gap-financing: This parcel is in a neighborhood with low assessed land values, so projects here may likely need extra ('gap') financing — this is just a note, not a penalty against the parcel [hood.median_land_psf].
flags.phfa-infill: Because this is vacant land in a lower-value area, it may qualify for special infill or blight-related scoring under PHFA's criteria, but this should be confirmed against their current rules [landuse.vacant, hood.median_land_psf].
flags.public-owner: This parcel is owned by the City, which may make it easier (though not guaranteed) to acquire through a public property disposition process [owner.type].
